structuredContent.body:
## Problem and exact result

The original spectral notes state that nonzero integer carry charge requires a paired coefficient nine. This contribution completes that claim for the **actual outgoing decimal carries**, preserving the original U/S charge and the existing decimal representation.

For `q : Nat → Nat` and `L : Nat`, the outgoing word is exactly `(List.range L).map (fun i => DecimalDigits.carry q (i+1))`. Under `∀ i<L, q i≤18`, its charge is zero iff every reflected outgoing pair agrees. With coefficient symmetry added, its charge is nonzero iff some in-range coefficient equals nine **and** its two reflected computed outgoing carries differ. The no-nine implication follows. Four endpoints specialize directly to existing `Canonical n d L` and `columnSum d L`.

Widths zero and one, both parities, the final outgoing carry including zero, overflow, and the free odd center are covered. The occurrence of nine alone is insufficient; a concrete kernel-checked zero-charge example is included.

## Implementation and exact source identity

One new mathematical module, `ActualCarrySupport.lean`, reuses PR145's exact charge theorem and the existing `RawSymmetryObstruction.nonnine_binary_div`. There are 22 explicit declarations (two definitions and 20 theorems), with four concrete controls.

- Mathematical freeze: `5d02e88f13f59f6fcd09cf75d8c7f188c6645727`.
- Source blob: `c0e5562e1661570546bced3dca82dd4fb459fa5f`.
- Source SHA256: `4c06522efae7aa254b6281003d042e49f6b60162d01d00881d50052c7a73c646`.
- Complete evidence checkpoint: `6fbb11ea4446e5ecbd0dea6798952d57679ef31c`.
- Final documentation head: `708aa41b28150a0618aa2aa8f1cf2b5bbed33615`; tree `fa7300c510ff3fc8e8c55a93ce029428ea30afff`.

## Verification

Official Lean4.19.0, compiler6caaee842e94, pinned executable and all1,471 installed runtime objects. Both fresh project builds use `--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false`.

| Gate | Actual evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Author canonical checker | Eight-module fresh source closure;10 Lean commands;37 explicit/critical declaration and axiom prints. |
| Genuine independent semantic review | Exact original note/script, contract, all22 named declarations, all seven dependencies, canonical arithmetic, indices and boundary cases: PASS. |
| Genuine independent execution | Separate eight-module fresh build; actual signature/axiom coverage for all2,410 origin constants. |
| Safe mathematical closure | 1,525 safe declarations, including93 private; axiom union only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. |
| Full public printing | 36 safe public origin constants plus12 prerequisites,48 complete `pp.all` prints; supplemental zero-ellipsis audit. |

The885 compiler implementation artifacts remain individually inventoried and separate from the safe proof closure. Their raw implementation-only axiom reports are preserved; they are not added to the permitted mathematical axiom set. The printing supplement reuses only the independently fresh objects and is not described as another full build.

## Reproduction and preservation

[README](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/708aa41b28150a0618aa2aa8f1cf2b5bbed33615/proofs/contributions/agent-15/spectral-carry-support-43cf6e114472/README.md), [exact contract](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/708aa41b28150a0618aa2aa8f1cf2b5bbed33615/proofs/contributions/agent-15/spectral-carry-support-43cf6e114472/CONTRACT.md), [immutable build configuration](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/708aa41b28150a0618aa2aa8f1cf2b5bbed33615/proofs/contributions/agent-15/spectral-carry-support-43cf6e114472/BUILD.json), and [acceptance record](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/708aa41b28150a0618aa2aa8f1cf2b5bbed33615/proofs/contributions/agent-15/spectral-carry-support-43cf6e114472/ACCEPTANCE.json) specify all inputs and commands. The canonical checker requires a new output directory and checks source, configuration, and runtime identity before and after execution.

The complete author, independent semantic and independent execution archives are retained, with exact manifests and readable reports. Failed proof/checker/publication attempts remain preserved. The runtime archive includes all11 fresh compiled products. Author archive omissions are only the16 regenerable compiled objects, individually hashed with original artifacts retained.

The scoped schema-1 registry does not assert a complete repository catalogue. The shared `verify_project` runner was NOT_RUN; acceptance rests on the two actual fresh builds and separately attributed semantic/axiom gates.

Ordinary ancestry-based integration must preserve the final PR145 evidence added after this branch forked.

Agent15 holds no main write slot or separate delivery claim. Main integration and shared-registry reconciliation are pending with the designated integration coordinator. app.description:
# 🦉 What is GitGuardian?

GitGuardian Secrets Detection detects and fixes vulnerabilities in source code at every step of the software development lifecycle, covering 350+ types of secrets like API keys, database connection strings, private keys, certificates, and more. The platform’s policy engine enables security teams to monitor and enforce rules across their VCS, DevOps tools, and infrastructure-as-code configurations. Our automated remediation playbooks and collaboration features bring security and development teams together to resolve incidents fast and in full.

## 1. Scan your codebase for 350+ types of secrets
GitGuardian scans your GitHub repositories and raises alerts only for critical secrets, such as API keys or other credentials. At scale, GitGuardian’s detection algorithm has been battle-tested on over three years of activity in all public GitHub repositories – totaling over 1 billion scanned commits!

## 2. Quickly remediate your hard-coded secrets
If you ever experience a leak involving a credential, we have a complete remediation guide used by 100k+ developers each year. We’ll show you how to revoke the secret and remove it from your git history.

##  3. Prevent secrets from reaching GitHub
Install ggshield, the GitGuardian CLI, and add secrets detection to your local development workflow using pre-commit and pre-push git hooks integrations.

# 🙋‍♂️ FAQ

**What is your pricing?**
GitGuardian is free for teams under 25 developers and offers a 30-day trial for larger teams.

**How can I be sure that GitGuardian won’t raise too many false positives?**
We have scanned billions of commits, sent millions of alerts since 2018, and integrated each feedback to improve our algorithm. Our alerts currently receive 91% “true positive” feedback from developers.

**My repositories are private; why should I install automated secret detection?**
Imagine if there were a plain text file with all your credit card numbers inside, you wouldn’t put this file inside your company’s git repository. Secrets are just as sensitive and should be handled with special care.

**Is GitGuardian available to be installed on-premise?**
Yes, you can contact one of our security specialists to look over the possibility of installing GitGuardian on-premise on your repositories.

# ⚒️ Installation notes 

You should install GitGuardian directly through your [GitGuardian](https://dashboard.gitguardian.com/) workspace on the Integration settings page. 

So that you know, your GitHub organization or GitHub account can only be associated with a single GitGuardian workspace.

# 👋 Support

If you experience any difficulties or have any questions, please reach out to us by email ([support@gitguardian.com](mailto:support@gitguardian.com)).
